gui.stacksnotslots.browser_direction: Change the side where the browser opens
gui.stacksnotslots.dump_to_container: Dump inventory into the open container (Shift mode)
gui.stacksnotslots.extract_from_containe: Extract the open container into inventory
gui.stacksnotslots.tabs_are_views: Tabs rearrange the visible grid only when clicked. Hotbar bindings only affect cycle keys.
gui.stacksnotslots.choose_hotbar_slot: Choose a hotbar slot to assign its cycle category
gui.stacksnotslots.choose_hotbar_categor: Choose the cycle category for hotbar slot %s
gui.stacksnotslots.pickups_hotbar_on: Picked-up items may enter the hotbar: ON
gui.stacksnotslots.pickups_hotbar_off: Picked-up items may enter the hotbar: OFF
gui.stacksnotslots.name: Tab name
tooltip.stacksnotslots.name: The name shown when this category icon is hovered.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.icon: Optional item ID or #tag used as the icon. Leave blank to cycle through included rules.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.pickup_limit: Maximum capacity this category may occupy. -1 disables this category-specific limit.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.sort: Default order applied to the visible main grid when this category is clicked.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.rule_search: Search item names/IDs, begin with # for item tags, or @ for a whole mod. Tag and mod previews cycle through matching items.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.edit_mode: Choose whether search results add include or exclude rules.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.browser_view: LIST shows named rows; GRID shows compact item cells. Choices: LIST or GRID (default).
tooltip.stacksnotslots.auto_browser_side: When enabled, dragging the handle beyond the center dead zone chooses LEFT, RIGHT, TOP, or BOTTOM automatically.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.grid_columns: Columns shown when opening left/right; becomes the row count when opening top/bottom. Range 1-16; default 4.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.grid_rows: Rows shown when opening left/right; becomes the column count when opening top/bottom. In LIST mode this remains the preferred row count. Range 1-20; default 6.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.item_count_mode: Item count choices: Exact, Compact (default), Stacks, Stacks plus remainder, or Percentage of total capacity.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.overall_count_mod: Capacity count choices: Exact, Compact, Stacks (default), or Percentage.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.dead_zone_x: Horizontal half-width in screen pixels around the center where automatic side selection does not change. Default 48.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.dead_zone_y: Vertical half-height in screen pixels around the center where automatic side selection does not change. Default 36.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.bulk_overlay: Shows a compact item grid after an in-world dump or extraction. The counts are rounded up to stacks.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.overlay_seconds: How long the in-world bulk-transfer grid remains visible. Range 0.25-30 seconds; default 2.5.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.handle_icon: Item ID rendered on the draggable browser handle. Default minecraft:spyglass.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.default_browser_p: Default handle anchor for container-screen types without a saved position. Choices: bottom, center, or top on either side. Bottom Right aligns beside the player's hotbar.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.configurable_icon: Item ID rendered on this square control. Use namespace:item, such as minecraft:name_tag.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.clear_visible_rul: Remove every rule from the currently displayed include or exclude list.
tooltip.stacksnotslots.enabled: Disabled categories remain editable but are hidden from inventory selectors.
message.stacksnotslots.unsafe_sophistica: Sophisticated Core's %s control is bound to plain left-click and is blocking its inventory UI. Rebind it under Controls.
